§ About that tie
Two pairs finished level: The Black Count and Easy Money on 47, and Born to Run and The Eureka Machine on 40. The methodology calls for a Condorcet head-to-head first: ignore the rest of the ballot and ask how each voter ranked the two against one another.
Head-to-head
The Black Count 5 · Easy Money 4
Both pairs separated cleanly. The Black Count beat Easy Money 5–4 and takes the higher of the two fifth places, and Born to Run beat The Eureka Machine 6–3 and takes the higher of the two ninth places. No fall-through to first-place votes was needed.
